visualCharacteristics: A 'Resources' band (rendered on a dark section background) with a centered heading, an optional subgroup label (e.g. 'Other'), and a vertical list of downloadable document links, each preceded by a download icon.
contentPattern: One row per resource link; an optional leading text-only row acts as a subgroup heading. Links are direct document URLs authored inline.
usage: Product detail pages — bottom 'Resources' download band.
